Container.Name: qualtrics-mcp-server
Container.Overview: MCP (Model Context Protocol) server for Qualtrics survey programming. It gives any MCP client 112 tools to build surveys, edit flow logic, and manage quotas, contacts, distributions and responses.[br][br]This template runs the Streamable HTTP endpoint at http://[server]:[port]/mcp (health check at /healthz).[br][br][b]Authentication is required.[/b] Set an API key (MCP_AUTH_TOKEN), Cloudflare Access (CF_ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN and CF_ACCESS_AUD), or both; either is accepted. The container refuses to start with neither. Clients send the key as X-API-Key or Authorization: Bearer.[br][br]The server starts read-only. Clients enable write scopes per session, or set Read Only to false to enable them all at startup.[br][br]The port is open on your LAN. Put it behind a TLS-terminating reverse proxy or a Cloudflare Tunnel before exposing it to the internet. Large survey exports are written to the Exports path.
Container.Requires: A Qualtrics API token and your data center ID.

Config.Name: MCP Port
Config.Description: Port for the MCP endpoint (http://server:port/mcp). The container always listens on 3000.

Config.Name: Exports
Config.Description: Where large survey response exports are saved. Tool results report the container path /home/node/Downloads/..., which is this folder. It must be writable by nobody:users (99:100).

Config.Name: Qualtrics API Token
Config.Description: Your Qualtrics API token (Account Settings, Qualtrics IDs, API).

Config.Name: Qualtrics Data Center
Config.Description: Your data center ID, such as iad1 or yul1. It is the first part of your Qualtrics account URL.

Config.Name: API Key
Config.Description: Shared secret clients send as X-API-Key or Authorization: Bearer. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32. Set this, the Cloudflare Access pair below, or both. The container will not start with neither.

Config.Name: Cloudflare Access Team Domain
Config.Description: Optional. Your Access team domain, such as myteam.cloudflareaccess.com. Set together with the Audience tag. Access tokens are verified by the server, not just trusted.

Config.Name: Cloudflare Access Audience
Config.Description: Optional. The Audience (AUD) tag of your Cloudflare Access application. Set together with the team domain.

Config.Name: Read Only
Config.Description: true blocks every write and delete until a client enables a write scope for its session. false enables all write scopes at startup for every session.

Config.Name: Allowed Hosts
Config.Description: Optional. Comma-separated Host header allowlist (DNS-rebinding protection), such as mcp.example.com.

Config.Name: Allowed Origins
Config.Description: Optional. Comma-separated Origin header allowlist, such as https://mcp.example.com.

Config.Name: Qualtrics Base URL
Config.Description: Optional. Override the Qualtrics API v3 base URL. Leave empty to use https://DATACENTER.qualtrics.com/API/v3.

Config.Name: Rate Limit (requests/min)
Config.Description: Client-side limit on Qualtrics API requests per minute, per session.
